title: Minor : app version on UI no more in red if built with workflow
symptom: When building the last dev using 'browser build', even though the code is changed (automation % change only), the app version on the UI is not red as it was when built using Android Studio.
cause: The red version number only appears when building within Android Studio with uncommitted changes. Browser build uses a branch pushed to the repo, so there are no uncommitted changes in the repo; uncommitted updates remain only on the local computer and are not pushed.
fix: To use browser build with personal updates, you need to commit them, push your local branch to your repo, and then Browser Build will create the expected APKs.
evidence_quote: it's red within Android Studio when you build à working branch with uncommited changes. - if you use Browser build, you build branch pushed within your repo, so you cannot have uncommited changes within your repo
